notes: Build 039 clarifies manager ownership: employee personal settings display manager name/contact read-only and do not persist those fields as employee-owned profile data. Automatic reflection of manager changes across user accounts requires shared backend directory/profile synchronization; this is not claimed as live until connected. Profile photo/background and personal contact settings remain browser-local.
